"Ruin" is a strong word. There are some minor spoilers for Heaven's Feel in Zero. Okay maybe medium-sized spoilers. But it's fine, honestly.

It's tricky. Anime-only, you'd want to start with Deen's Fate route. But it's shit, so, forget that. Next is Ufotable's Unlimited Blade Works, which is a good enough starting point. Now, optimally, you'd wait for the Heaven's Feel movies for another 1 or 2 years, THEN watch Fate/Zero. But who has the patience for that, considering Fate/Zero is the best fucking anime ever made.

I'm gonna cheat a little bit since one of these isn't anime yet, but basically every route of Fate/Stay Night has that one big tear jerker moment. Spoiler tags just in case.

[Fate](/s "when Saber hugs Shirou and realises he was her scabbard the entire time.")

[UBW](/s "Archer's last moments, when he tells Tohsaka to take care of Shirou")

 [HF](/s "when Shirou hugs Sakura in the park and says "I'll be your hero of justice"")

That last one especially, when it has all the weight of the previous routes behind it. It's honestly probably the most powerful scene I have ever seen in any media. Now excuse me I think I have something in my eye...
